rules.statement: The court should have performed its duties under Section 25 of the Partition Act, No. 16 of 1951 to examine the title of each party and hear evidence in support thereof.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this case the trial judge has failed to perform these duties and it is not too late for us to require him to perform them at another trial."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25 of the Partition Act, No. 16 of 1951
